svg.aria-label: Trust every change from laptop to production
svg.title: Trust every change from laptop to production

g.text: Trust every change from laptop to production
Three gates, one evidence bundle. If a change cannot be verified, it cannot advance.
1 · Every change starts at the pre-commit hook
2 · Fast checks pass, so it commits with confidence
3 · Deeper local checks pass before anything is shared
4 · The release ships with verifiable, signed evidence
5 · A failed check stops the change at the source
7 · Fix the cause, then the change goes round again
